description: Las Vegas Sands Corp. is a Fortune 500 company and the leading global developer and operator of destination properties, known as Integrated Resorts, that feature premium accommodations, world-class gaming, entertainment and retail malls, convention and exhibition facilities, celebrity chef restaurants and other amenities. It currently owns and operates Integrated Resorts in Macao and Singapore, and it believes its geographic diversity, best-in-class properties and meeting and convention facilities provide it with the best platform in the hospitality and gaming industry to attract leisure and business tourism to its markets and continue generating growth and cash flow while simultaneously pursuing new development opportunities. The scale of its properties enables it to offer a range of amenities to serve the widest array of customer segments in each market, and it focuses on the mass market, which is its most profitable gaming segment.
